svg.aria-label: NetOps Sentinel, my biggest project so far. An animated network lab: two hosts exchange packets through two routers watched by Prometheus. Router R1 goes down, an alert opens an incident, evidence is collected, an AI model suggests a likely cause, I confirm, and the router comes back.
svg.title: NetOps Sentinel
svg.text: My biggest project so far. When something breaks in my network lab, it opens an incident,
collects the evidence and asks an AI what probably happened. I make the call.

g.text: Check that the VM is running.
